name: SHE Score (v3) — reweighted five-pillar + expansion framework (SHADOW)
description: Shadow-only. v3 REWEIGHTS the five LIVE pillars relative to v2 — heavier Economic Inclusion (0.20->0.25) and Safety/Crime penalty (0.20->0.25), lighter Empowerment (0.25->0.20) and Education (0.20->0.15); Health is unchanged. It is a stricter lens, so most scores fall a few points versus v2. The reweighting uses ONLY existing pillar data; nothing is imputed. Four further candidate pillars remain provisional (weight null) and in validation — they MUST NOT affect published scores or $SHE supply mechanics. v3 scores are computed only where indicator data exists; missing data is recorded as insufficient coverage, never imputed.
